simple.summary: חָגָב (Châgâb) means Chagab , one of the Nethinim First listed occurrence: Ezra 2 46.

definitions.full: H2285. Chagab II. חָגָּב proper name, masculine head of a family of returning exiles Ezra 2:46 ᵐ5 Ἁγαβ (no || in Nehemiah 7 H; but ᵐ5 L Neh 7:48 has both Αγαβ and Αγαβα , compare חֲגָבָא ).
